query:
MATCH (p:player)
RETURN p.id AS id, p.age AS age
ORDER BY age DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC
OFFSET 1
LIMIT 2;
notes: Assumes the evaluator-selected graph and the supplied player label/schema. Returns the requested id and age column names, preserves nullable ages without a filter, orders age descending with NULLS LAST and unique id ascending before OFFSET 1 LIMIT 2. References: SKILL.md; references/documented-syntax.md ORDER BY; references/query-language.md RETURN and ORDER BY / OFFSET / LIMIT; references/identifiers.md; references/checklist.md; applicable references/validation.md checks. Bundled quote-identifiers confirmed player, id and age are ordinary identifiers. No database execution.
